disposition_reason: The paper contains an ordered consciousness-state prediction task in Figure 5, with a published random-forest balanced-accuracy baseline. This can support a source-grounded improvement design. The local state-contrast evaluator does not implement that task, and original responsiveness timing, exact train/evaluation samples and full Figure 5 comparisons remain unresolved.

source_paper.title: Measuring the dynamic balance of integration and segregation underlying consciousness, anesthesia, and sleep in humans

evidence.locator: Figure 5b,c,i,j and Results describing predictive power; Methods: Training and evaluation of machine learning models
evidence.supports: Original consciousness-state prediction uses balanced accuracy/AUC, subject-level validation and cross-dataset tests. Dataset-1 random forest reaches reported balanced accuracy 93% and AUC 0.984.

evidence.locator: Methods: Dataset-1; Dataset-2; fMRI data preprocessing and regional time course extraction; Training and evaluation of machine learning models
evidence.supports: Primary-article XML establishes original cohorts, paired preprocessing, network features, state exclusions and classifier settings. Dataset-2 training-state names require reconciliation with the stated awake/LOR class sampling.

evidence.locator: Version 1 description and Raw Data.zip metadata, file 47912122; DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.26367193.v1
evidence.supports: Five released datasets have paired GSR/noGSR MAT files. Dataset-1 is 19 participants x 8370 TRs x 450 ROIs; Dataset-2 is 26 x 5576 x 450. Metadata does not expose per-participant responsiveness annotations.
Integration averages binary-graph efficiency on noGSR correlations over thresholds 0.01 through 1.00; segregation averages clustering on GSR correlations; ISD subtracts the two.
The inspected repository documents network-measure, metastability and complexity computation; it does not establish a reproduced Figure 5 classifier.

target.description: Predict behaviorally assessed awake versus loss-of-responsiveness states, retaining original within-dataset, transition-period and cross-dataset Figure 5 comparisons.

dataset.description: Original Dataset-1 and Dataset-2 paired GSR/noGSR regional BOLD arrays from Figshare 26367193 version 1; Dataset-3/4/5 static state contrasts do not substitute for the Figure 5 prediction task.

cohort.description: Retain all original analyzed Dataset-1 (19) and Dataset-2 (26) participants. The full original classifier population and both transfer directions are required; no easier cohort subset is admitted.

split.description: Paper specifies leave-one-subject-out validation, stable-state training and tests across datasets. Exact sample/seed manifests and transition exclusions are unbound. Methods lists Dataset-2 training periods that appear to omit Rest2/Music2 despite sampling both awake and LOR classes; this requires source reconciliation.

inputs.description: Original classifier uses integration and segregation from whole brain plus eight networks (18 features). Per-participant awake/LOR labels and loss/return-of-responsiveness times must be joined to the released arrays; public metadata alone does not establish this mapping.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original 450-ROI extraction, Pearson dynamic connectivity in 4-minute windows stepping by one TR, and paired GSR/noGSR processing. Efficiency uses noGSR and clustering uses GSR, averaged over thresholds 0.01 through 1.00. Transition times and behavioral labels are targets, not predictor features.

metric.description: Balanced accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity)/2, higher is better; ROC AUC remains a separate reported endpoint. Static ISD and state-contrast significance are not classification accuracy.

aggregation.description: Figure 5 reports mean and SEM across subjects for subject-out evaluations; preserve each within-dataset and cross-dataset result separately. Time windows within a participant do not create independent participants.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5 Dataset-1 leave-one-subject-out awake/LOR balanced accuracy, with original transition and cross-dataset comparisons retained

published_baseline.description: Reported Dataset-1 random-forest balanced accuracy is 93%; AUC is 0.984. This rounded anchor is not the approximately 75% cross-dataset result or 87% transition result. Exact source-data precision and all secondary Figure 5 scores must be recovered before admission.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No Figure 5 author-classifier replay is established. Methods gives a 100-tree random forest and five randomly considered features per split, but the available network-measure kernel and local ISD evaluator do not reproduce classifier predictions.

minimum_effect.rationale: No source-backed practically meaningful balanced-accuracy increment is established. Resolve the rounded reference and variation across subjects before predeclaring an effect requirement; a universal percentage-point margin would be invented.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired candidate-minus-author uncertainty over original subject-level predictions, respecting within-subject temporal dependence and separate dataset/transfer comparisons. The source SEM is not a candidate-comparison decision rule.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant, with all time windows kept together; datasets remain separate
uncertainty.rationale: Highly overlapping BOLD windows cannot be treated as independent samples, and LOSO fit overlap requires an explicitly justified comparison procedure.

paper_win_requires: Recover and reproduce the original Figure 5 state-label/time mapping, sample policy, feature definitions, subject folds and random-forest baseline before comparing candidates.
Exceed the exact underlying Dataset-1 balanced-accuracy baseline, not merely the rounded 0.93, with a predeclared meaningful effect and valid subject-level uncertainty rule.

Retain original Dataset-1 and Dataset-2 cohorts, original transition windows and both transfer directions; predeclare their comparison requirements before candidate evaluation rather than selecting the easiest Figure 5 panel.

Do not claim a win from stronger ISD state separation, smaller p-values, a Dataset-3/4/5-only classifier, pooled random windows, or a new split; those are descriptive results or separately labelled extensions.
Keep AUC, balanced accuracy and static ISD distinct, and report source-paper, reproduced-author and candidate scores separately.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA source comparison was performed.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery and admission, iterate only on original training/development participants and allowed feedback under a declared total fitting/search budget; preserve the original evaluation cases.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze feature extraction, model, hyperparameters, seed policy, code and all preprocessing before the original held-subject/transfer assessment. Resolve how historical public results and hyperparameter selection are handled before access.
episode.final_evaluation: Owner executes the frozen candidate and recovered author classifier on matched original Figure 5 folds and transfer tests; evaluates subject-level predictions and separate transition outcomes without returning iterative held-out feedback.
episode.baseline_policy: Published rounded Figure 5 scores, an exact reproduced author classifier, and current SOTA are distinct. The existing local state-contrast evaluator is calibration only; refitting both methods on a new partition creates an extension.

blocking_issues: Authentic per-participant responsiveness labels and induction/emergence times are not bound to released Dataset-1/2 arrays.
Resolve Dataset-2 stable-state training list versus awake/LOR class sampling in Methods and recover exact sampled points/seed policy.
Recover source-data precision for the 93% baseline and all original Figure 5 transition/transfer scores; no held-label file was read during this audit.
Build and validate the original classifier/evaluator rather than treating the source-as-written ISD kernel as a prediction benchmark.
Qualify participant-level uncertainty, meaningful effect, equal access and concrete cumulative resource/search budgets before activation.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 ISD calculations and prospective paired state contrasts. Its Dataset-3/5 policy, withheld Dataset-4 and hypothetical classifier proposal do not implement Figure 5 and cannot establish improvement over the paper.
